retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban collage featuring a dual-tone color split, palm tree silhouettes, and bold, layered typography typical of 2000s West Coast rap covers.
triggerTerms: urban street collage with palm trees
excludeWhen: corporate or clean professional branding is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring two central figures against a background split vertically into blue and red halves. The scene is populated with urban icons like palm trees and lowriders, using high-contrast lighting and sharp, metallic-textured typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical color split (blue left, red right) defining the two subjects
Silhouetted palm trees framing the central figures
Lowrider cars positioned at the bottom corners for environmental context
Bold, metallic-effect typography anchored at the top and bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two primary subjects centered, waist-up, filling the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, metallic title text at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top artist names, move down through the subjects, and land on the main title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects, cars, trees, and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and vibrant red split vertically to represent opposing sides.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black silhouettes of palm trees and shadows provide depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White and metallic silver for typography and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background colors with deep blacks and bright white highlights on the subjects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of Blackletter and bold Sans-Serif
letterConstructionRules: Top-left text uses ornate, gothic blackletter strokes
Top-right text uses wide, blocky sans-serif with horizontal emphasis
Main title uses high-contrast serif with metallic beveling and drop shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking 'LA' monogram in the center background
Horizontal bars extending from the main title letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting ornate gothic script with modern, wide industrial sans-serifs.

preserve: The contrast between the script and block fonts
The metallic texture of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the gothic blackletter style of the top-left text
Captures the wide, blocky feel of the secondary text
Provides the high-contrast serif base for the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-tone background with deep blue on the left and vibrant red on the right. Include silhouetted palm trees and two lowrider cars at the bottom corners. Place two men in urban streetwear in the center, one on each color side, with high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply metallic silver text at the top and bottom. Use a gothic font for the top-left, a wide sans-serif for the top-right, and a large, beveled serif font for the main title at the bottom. Add a white 'LA' monogram in the center background.

verificationChecks: Is the background clearly split into blue and red?
Does the main title have a metallic, 3D effect?
Are there lowrider cars in the bottom corners?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the vertical color split is centered
Ensure the typography looks heavy and metallic
Check that the palm trees are silhouetted correctly
Confirm the presence of urban elements like lowriders
